source: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), all homes plus multifamily, smoothed, ZIP level
unit: USD per month (asking rent, excludes utilities)
aggregation: median of ZIP window-means across the MHA's ZIPs (unweighted); real MHAs only
utilities_adjustment: zori_utilities_adjusted = zori_median / rent_share (B5, DTMO component split). Uses DTMO's cost structure, not the BAH dollar amount. Shares rounded to 1% at source.
warnings: 862 ZIP(s) had fewer than 3 months in the window and were left out
